title: A Guardian and a Thief

vibeProfile.oneLine: In a flooded future Kolkata, a stolen purse threatens a family's escape.

summary: In a near-future Kolkata ravaged by flood and famine, a woman known as Ma is days from getting her small daughter and elderly father out of the country to join her husband in America, when a young, starving homeless thief steals the purse holding their hard-won immigration papers and climate visas. Over a single desperate week, Ma is pushed into ever darker moral compromises to salvage the family's escape. Megha Majumdar's second novel is a taut, unsettling story of climate displacement, love and the choices desperation forces.
whyReadIt: Majumdar's taut climate-crisis novel of a family's desperate escape from a drowning Kolkata. Unsettling and morally fierce.

funFacts.text: It was a finalist for the 2025 National Book Award for Fiction.
